key_insight: RATED improves AI tool retrieval by combining semantic matching with real-time execution feedback to avoid selecting unavailable tools.
engineering_relevance: The method is directly useful for building more reliable agentic systems in production, where tool outages and runtime failures can break otherwise accurate retrieval pipelines.
method: Frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic tool-query matching
Lightweight contextual bandit re-ranker adapts retrieval using execution dynamics and feedback
Designed to update reliability decisions without expensive retraining or added latency
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates on EcoAgent, a benchmark with 5,172 real-world tools and 210,000+ query-tool pairs, reporting a 52.2% relative MRR gain and a drop in fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under 30% API failure.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and timeliness of execution feedback, so noisy signals or sparse failures could weaken the bandit re-ranking behavior.
paper_title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
